description: This file contains PHP classes that implement the compilation logic for the {while} and {/while} tags in the Smarty templating engine, enabling dynamic generation of PHP code for loop constructs within Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_While
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {while} tag in Smarty templates, generating PHP code for while loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Whileclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/while} closing tag in Smarty templates, closing PHP while loops.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the {while} tag, supporting various condition formats including variable assignment within the loop.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the {/while} closing tag, properly closing the PHP while loop.
